$comment: Phase 0 of #1101: a rule-by-rule register of Worlds Without Number, not a chapter list. Status is a claim about this repository, and tools/wwn_register_audit.py verifies every named module and test actually exists. A row is only 'implemented' when the code and a test that exercises it are both present here. Deluxe rows are blocked because the Deluxe book is a commercial PDF that is not in this repository: no procedure may be transcribed from it until an authorized agent reads the purchased copy.

wwn_srd.document: Worlds Without Number System Reference Document (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine)
wwn_srd.note: The CC0 dedication covers the System Reference Document. It is not a finding that the full commercial Worlds Without Number book is CC0, and it does not extend to the Deluxe material, art or protected setting text.

wwn_free_pdf.document: Worlds Without Number Free Edition PDF
wwn_free_pdf.note: Mirror of the free rules. Treated as the same grant as the SRD: it is not the Deluxe edition.

wwn_deluxe.document: Worlds Without Number Deluxe (commercial PDF, user-supplied, not in this repository)
wwn_deluxe.note: Not available to repository agents. Chapters G-K below stay blocked and unverified by rule of #1101: do not synthesize mechanics from chapter names, table-of-contents entries or recollection.

cwn_srd.document: Cities Without Number System Reference Document
cwn_srd.note: Primary character-scale game. Its published mechanics are immutable; WWN rows reuse it by delegation rather than reimplementing it.

swn.document: Stars Without Number (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine)
swn.note: The rights ledger (issue #200) records SWN as NOT VERIFIED and deliberately not promoted: no SWN SRD licence page has been read and recorded. Nothing may be imported while that entry stands.

awn.note: No Ashes Without Number SRD was located. The CWN and WWN CC0 SRDs do not extend to it. Nothing may be imported while that entry stands.

statuses.implemented: Code and a test that exercises it are both present in this repository.
statuses.partial: Some of the procedure exists; the row states exactly how much and what is missing.
statuses.verified_reuse: The published procedure is satisfied by delegating to an already-verified subsystem rather than by a second implementation.
statuses.missing: No implementation. This is the default and requires no justification.
statuses.blocked: Cannot be done from a source an agent may read — the purchased Otherscape book, for example, is not in the repository. Deluxe is NOT blocked: it has been read and its sections are in data/rules/wwn_sections.json.
statuses.not_applicable: Explicitly ruled out, with the decision recorded.

rows.subsystem: Six attributes and their modifiers
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 4; tracker chapter A
rows.tabletop: CWN attribute band 3-18 with the same modifier table; no WWN second attribute system.
rows.notes: The tracker requires delegation to CWN, not a parallel attribute system. Attribute modifiers are pinned in tests/test_duplication_audit_1053.py as well, which asserts every layer agrees.

rows.subsystem: Backgrounds, origin, training and starting equipment
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 4 onward; tracker chapter A
rows.notes: Must be optional WWN-native packages with an explicit CWN mapping, never a replacement for CWN skills.

rows.subsystem: Class packages: Warrior, Expert, Mage, Adventurer partial classes
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 4 onward; tracker chapter A
rows.notes: Hit dice, foci, advancement and spell eligibility must be implemented as published without overwriting CWN PC progression.

rows.subsystem: Foci, advancement and partial-class restrictions
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 4 onward; tracker chapter A
rows.notes: Conversion and compatibility procedures belong here where the original material supports them.

rows.subsystem: WWN character and NPC sheet aids
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter A
rows.notes: Printable aids only. CWN-first characters and saves must be preserved.

rows.chapter: B. The Rules of the Game
rows.subsystem: Skill checks, saves, reactions and morale
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B
rows.tabletop: CWN skill check and save procedures; WWN reuses them.
rows.notes: A resolver exists, but the equivalence audit the tracker asks for (WWN procedure against CWN, with published mapping tests) has not been written. Reactions and morale are not evidenced in this repository.

rows.chapter: B. The Rules of the Game
rows.subsystem: Initiative, encumbrance, travel, healing, downtime and System Strain
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B
rows.tabletop: CWN group initiative; System Strain as published.
rows.notes: Initiative is implemented. Encumbrance, overland travel, healing and downtime procedures are not evidenced here.

rows.chapter: B. The Rules of the Game
rows.subsystem: Combat action economy, Shock, armour, damage and hazards
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B
rows.tabletop: CWN combat; WWN-specific behaviour applies only to WWN creatures and equipment.
rows.notes: CWN combat exists. WWN Shock and its interaction with WWN armour have not been separately verified, and must not be folded into CWN combat.

rows.chapter: B. The Rules of the Game
rows.subsystem: Survival, exploration, crafting and magical-item use
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B
rows.notes: Relevant to strange sites and anomalous enclaves, which is where NoöPunk will use it.

rows.chapter: B. The Rules of the Game
rows.subsystem: Mapping tests for reused versus supplemental rules
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter B
rows.notes: The tracker requires verified mapping tests including cross-game counterexamples. Without these, 'reuse' is an assertion rather than a finding.

rows.subsystem: High Mage class, Arts, casting, preparation and Effort
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C
rows.tabletop: High Mage class as published, reskinned as hermetic ritual PSI without changing numbers.
rows.notes: Delivered by #1044, which is closed. The tracker's instruction is to audit this before extending it, not to rewrite it.

rows.subsystem: Elementalist class procedures
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C
rows.notes: The 15 Elementalist spell identities are catalogued in data/rules/wwn_spells.json, but the class, its Arts and its Effort pool are not implemented.

rows.subsystem: Necromancer class procedures
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C
rows.notes: The 16 Necromancer spell identities are catalogued; the class and its Arts are not implemented.

rows.subsystem: Spell corpus and learning procedure
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C
rows.tabletop: Learning, rescribing and free spells per level, by spell level and tradition.
rows.notes: 83 spell identities: 52 high magic, 15 elementalist, 16 necromancer. Verified against the catalogue on 2026-11-03; the tracker's own count matches.

rows.subsystem: Spell effect resolution
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C
rows.tabletop: Range, duration, save, targets and damage per spell as printed.
rows.notes: 13 of 83 effects are transcribed: the level-1 High Magic batch delivered by #1095. 70 remain and #1085 owns them. No rival resolver may be built.

rows.subsystem: Spellbooks, research, prepared repertoire, magical duels and dispelling
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C

rows.subsystem: Effort pool separation between WWN Arts and SWN psychic powers
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter C
rows.notes: The tracker calls this out explicitly: SWN psychic Effort and WWN tradition Effort must not unintentionally share a pool. This is a boundary test that does not exist yet.

rows.chapter: D. World, Campaign and Adventure Tools
rows.subsystem: Worldbuilding tables: places, polities, communities, terrain, history, ruins
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD pp. 94-279; tracker chapter D
rows.notes: Implement as documented GM procedure and optional importable generators, not as game code that pretends to be a rule.

rows.chapter: D. World, Campaign and Adventure Tools
rows.subsystem: Sandbox campaign creation, adventure seeds, dungeons, hexcrawl and encounters
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD pp. 94-279; tracker chapter D

rows.chapter: D. World, Campaign and Adventure Tools
rows.subsystem: Conversion of WWN outputs into anomalous sites and crisis zones
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter D
rows.notes: Published roll procedures and original NoöPunk setting decisions must stay separate.

rows.chapter: D. World, Campaign and Adventure Tools
rows.subsystem: GM playability with dice and paper preserved
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter D
rows.notes: Automating table lookup must not make the tabletop procedure unplayable without the computer.

rows.chapter: E. Creatures of a Far Age
rows.subsystem: Creature and NPC stat-block model
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 280; tracker chapter E
rows.notes: HD, attacks, defences, saves, morale and conversion to CWN combat.

rows.chapter: E. Creatures of a Far Age
rows.subsystem: Creature templates, tags and generators
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 280; tracker chapter E

rows.chapter: E. Creatures of a Far Age
rows.subsystem: Otherworldly entities reskinned as NHI and noetic constructs
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter E
rows.notes: No stock Tolkien bestiary by default; mechanics retained, adaptation recorded.

rows.subsystem: Major Projects: renown, difficulty, opposition and completion
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 322; tracker chapter F
rows.tabletop: Project difficulty, renown awards and completion rolls.
rows.notes: Includes an explicit note on whether money purchase is modelled, so an omitted rule is visible rather than implied.

rows.subsystem: WWN faction creation, turns, stats, assets and conflicts
rows.source_ref: WWN SRD p. 322; tracker chapter F
rows.notes: The tracker requires auditing src/rules/swn_faction_*.py first: WWN and SWN faction mechanics complement one another and neither may replace the other.

rows.subsystem: WWN/SWN faction engine complementarity and shared event interfaces
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter F
rows.notes: Each asset keeps its native system and abstraction level; share identity, date and event interfaces only.

rows.subsystem: Interfaces to the NoöPunk Ideology Mod
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter F
rows.notes: Ideological positions must not accidentally become combat stats.

rows.subsystem: Tabletop faction turn, ledger and project sheets
rows.source_ref: tracker chapter F
rows.notes: No parallel faction tracking ledger may be introduced.

rows.subsystem: Arts of the Gyre: options, variants, prerequisites and side effects
rows.source_ref: WWN Deluxe p. 344 (verified against the authorised copy's running head; section 'Arts of the gyre', see data/rules/wwn_sections.json)

Nothing is implemented, so the honest status is 'missing', not 'blocked'. Redistribution of the Deluxe text remains prohibited; only page numbers and titles are recorded.

compatibility.cwn: Immutable baseline. Armour class and saving throws as published in the CWN SRD.
compatibility.wwn: Reuses the same resolution. WWN creature and equipment behaviour is supplemental and must be isolated.
compatibility.citation: CWN Free Edition p. 218 onward, 'Mixing Sine Nomine Games Together' (tracker citation); WWN SRD p. 38.

compatibility.cwn: PC progression, foci and skills are the baseline.
compatibility.wwn: Warrior, Expert, Mage and Adventurer are optional WWN-native packages mapping onto CWN, never overwriting it.
compatibility.precedence: CWN character progression is never replaced; a WWN class is an alternative package, not a rewrite.
compatibility.citation: Tracker chapter A; WWN SRD p. 4 onward.

compatibility.cwn: No spellcasting; System Strain is the CWN resource and must not be changed.
compatibility.wwn: Tradition Effort pools per mage class.
compatibility.precedence: Pools are separate by rule. Sharing one accidentally is a defect, not a design choice.

compatibility.cwn: The CWN skill list is authoritative for characters.
compatibility.wwn: Backgrounds and skills map onto CWN rather than replacing it.
compatibility.precedence: CWN vocabulary wins; WWN backgrounds are a mapping layer.

compatibility.cwn: Cyberware, gear and tech levels as published.
compatibility.wwn: Fantasy equipment is supplemental and must not silently retune CWN gear.
Creatures of a Far Age, with stat blocks converted to CWN combat.
compatibility.precedence: WWN entities resolve with WWN statistics, presented through CWN combat; NoöPunk reskins fiction only.
compatibility.citation: Tracker chapter E; WWN SRD p. 280.

compatibility.wwn: Faction turns, assets and Major Projects.
compatibility.swn: Faction mechanics, unverified as an import.
compatibility.precedence: WWN and SWN faction mechanics complement one another; neither replaces the other. Ideology is a mod interface, not a stat.
compatibility.citation: Tracker chapter F; WWN SRD p. 322.

compatibility.precedence: AWN owns survival stress; CWN System Strain is untouched by it.

phase0_gaps: The compatibility matrix cites the tracker's own page references. It has not been re-verified against a copy of the CWN Free Edition PDF page 218 in this pass.
The Deluxe chapters are blocked, so five of eleven chapters have no verifiable rows at all.

No equivalence audit exists for the rows marked verified_reuse; 'reuse' is currently a design decision with a test that the delegated code works, not a published mapping test against WWN procedure text.
title: WWN rules register (#1101, Phase 0)
intro: #1101 requires a rule-by-rule register before any code, with edition, printed section, rights, applicability, implementation, test, tabletop procedure, status, dependency and risk. This is that register. It is an audit, not a completion certificate.
